Check missing values against a specification

Source: R/checks.R
ysx_check_missing.Rd

Missing values are not allowed by default. A column may contain them only when its dots set na_ok: true. Missing values must be encoded as the spec's missing_code (SETUP__: missing_code, default NA). If missing_code is not NA, any NA in the data is an error, even when na_ok is true.

Usage

ysx_check_missing(data, spec, spec2 = NULL, error_on_fail = TRUE)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

spec

A loaded yspec object.

spec2

An optional second yspec object whose additional columns are merged into spec before checking.

error_on_fail

If TRUE (default), an error is raised when a column of data is not in the (merged) specification. If FALSE, such columns are returned as problems instead.

Value

A character vector of problems; character(0) if none are found. An error is raised if a na_ok setting is not true or false.

Details

Every column in data must be described in spec. With error_on_fail = TRUE an error lists the unmatched columns, because their missing-value rules cannot be checked; with FALSE they are returned as problems. Specification columns that are not in data are ignored.

If spec2 is supplied, it is merged into spec with yspec::ys_join() before checking. Columns in both specifications use the definition from spec, and metadata such as missing_code also comes from spec.
